acceptance.positive_growth: central rate and paired-bootstrap lower confidence limit must both be positive
acceptance.rate_preservation_rule: the entire paired 95% confidence interval must lie in [0.90, 1.10]
acceptance.unresolved_policy: do not add seeds, change the window, or extend the run after inspecting the result

analysis.primary_estimand: ratio of arithmetic means of paired individual-seed fitted growth rates
analysis.uncertainty_unit: paired seed index; identical resampled indices in CIC and q050_x000; no temporal resampling

cost.empirical_basis: completed E2 job 5195640 required about 0.45 CPU node-hour for ten concurrent t=60 histories; duration scaling to t=71.16 gives about 0.534 node-hour per concurrently packed ten-history arm
cost.packing: 10 one-thread q050_x000 histories concurrently on one CPU node; archived CIC is audited and copied without rerunning

existing_cic_reuse.pairing_evidence: production-runtime deterministic reconstruction from the archived wrapper, frozen configuration, explicitly hashed initializer sources and seeds; the new q050 runner must reproduce each reconstructed aggregate and per-array hash before time integration
existing_cic_reuse.pairing_limitation: job 5201231 did not save historical particle arrays or their hashes; matching seed numbers alone is not accepted as pairing evidence

historical_source_provenance.git_revision_scope: context only: the research Python tree was untracked by this repository revision, so the revision is not used as a content hash for those files
historical_source_provenance.mtime_evidence: the observed conventions.py and cic.py mtimes predate job 5201231; this is supporting evidence, not cryptographic provenance

filter_chain.deposition: perturbation-weight CIC followed by one Gaussian W
filter_chain.gather: one Gaussian W on nodal E followed by CIC interpolation

loading.scheme: regular marker lattice; global inverse-normal quiet-start thermal velocities; random balanced beam-sign permutation
loading.within_seed_pairing: q050_x000 records the actual initialized arrays; before time integration its production-runtime aggregate hash must match existing_cic_reuse.production_runtime_reconstructed_initial_state_sha256, and the reducer must also match every q050 per-array hash to the production-runtime reuse audit

model_prediction.name: audited warm oblique grid/time-discrete response, spatial aliases qmax=8, temporal aliases lmax=1024

poisson_solver: periodic spectral Poisson solve on the projected conjugate target-mode pair
scope: target-mode-projected linearized delta-f dynamics validation of the archived selected width; not a same-configuration full-f error-and-rate demonstration
seed_independence: dynamics seeds 200--209 are disjoint from bandwidth-selection seeds 100--104 and held-out static-error seeds 105--109, but they were previously analysed in job 5201231 and are not fresh dynamics seeds
seed_set_change_record: the original fresh paired-CIC design used seeds 105--114; it changed before any q050 dynamics result was inspected because exact compatible CIC histories were recovered for previously analysed seeds 200--209 and passed the historical-initialization compatibility audit
